title: Pullman's 18th Street wall gets its urn
items: 1729 Prairie's 18th Street wall now carries the stone urn that the 1894 Inland Architect plate shows on its fifth pier, in front of the stable. Read at full size, it is a single squat lidded urn about 0.4 m across. The turned shape is the shared kit's; the size comes from the plate.
